algorithm_profile.target_function: f(1)=1 and f is multiplicative with f(p^e)=p^(e-1), equivalently f(n)=n/rad(n).
algorithm_profile.convolution: Let g(n)=1 and h=mu*f. Then f=g*h, h(1)=1, h(p)=0, and h(p^e)=(p-1)*p^(e-2) for e>=2. The support of h consists exactly of powerful numbers.
algorithm_profile.summatory_identity: Return sum(h(d)*floor(N/d)) over powerful d<=N; the d=1 term is N.
algorithm_profile.enumeration: Sieve primes through floor(sqrt(N)); recursively choose increasing primes, each with exponent at least two, and accumulate every resulting powerful number exactly once.
algorithm_profile.complexity: Prime sieve O(sqrt(N)*log(log(N))) time and O(sqrt(N)) storage; powerful-number enumeration visits O(sqrt(N)) products and accumulates each term in O(1).

output.meaning: Exact sum of n/rad(n) for 1<=n<=N; -1 for invalid input.
